03-un-solo-panel.html.note: Implemented: 3-step wizard (nombre → progenitores → hijos), member search by name/email with removable chips and "Ya está" for picked users, create-account-in-place when nobody matches, children required (min 1) and sent in the same request. Backend now writes bond + members + children in one transaction (S15). Installed on the connected device; no loopback preview URL because the app is a physical Android build, not a web app.
